textual.limitations: These records do not verify the mining operation, investment outcome, registration destination, required fees, terms, or whether viewers actually transfer money or provide information.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes club mining as an earning opportunity, emphasizing minimal investment, fast returns, daily profit, and a claimed 14-fold increase in personal investments over three months. The speaker invites viewers to build the business with him and directs them to register for more information, making this a solicitation for paid mining participation rather than neutral financial commentary.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because the promoted participation is club mining linked to recurring income claims, including fast returns and daily profit, alongside a minimum-investment entry point. The video also presents a registration pathway and an explicit call to learn more, establishing promotion of mining participation rather than merely discussing cryptocurrency.
